text:
[issue by Seceroth]
Hello,

An Obsidian furnace is crashing my server. Had it set to auto input fuel from the left side, pulling from a chest. It has the furnace and blasting upgrades. Iron ingots were just arriving into the chest and then it crashed. Restarting the server does not the fix the issue. As soon as I load the chunk it's in, the same crash happens. Playing the FTB Evolution modpack (v1.20.0). 
Iron Furnaces Version 1.21.1 - 4.3.0.

[crash-2025-07-22_18.59.13-server.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21373802/crash-2025-07-22_18.59.13-server.txt)

Update: Turns out there was also a poppy in the chest, might be relevant.

[comment by Reaviik (none)]
same crash here

[comment by Qelifern (owner)]
4.3.1 fixes this, a quick fix as I dont have the time to do thorough testing, therefore letting issue be up if any further issues arise
